senses.sense_definition: A work of art, such as a painting or carving, consisting of three panels or sections joined together by hinges.

examples.text: The museum displayed a beautiful medieval <w>triptych</w> featuring religious scenes on its three wooden panels.
The artist painted a modern <w>triptych</w> that tells a story across three connected canvases.

senses.sense_definition: A collection or series of three related works, people, or ideas that form a unified whole.

examples.text: These three novels form a <w>triptych</w> exploring the history of the same family over several decades.
The director created a <w>triptych</w> of films that examine the social challenges of modern urban life.

senses.sense_definition: A film or video installation designed to be projected simultaneously across three separate screens.

examples.text: The experimental film was presented as a <w>triptych</w> to immerse the audience in the landscape.
Viewers watched the <w>triptych</w> as images flowed seamlessly from the left screen to the right.

senses.sense_definition: A set of three postage stamps printed together that create a single continuous image.

examples.text: The collector was excited to find a rare <w>triptych</w> of stamps from the early twentieth century.
Each stamp in the <w>triptych</w> shows a different part of the national park's scenery.
